meta.name: product-manager-toolkit
meta.description: Comprehensive toolkit for product managers including RICE prioritization, customer interview analysis, PRD templates, discovery frameworks, and go-to-market strategies. Use for feature prioritization, user research synthesis, requirement documentation, and product strategy development.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用框架和模板系统化推进产品管理工作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是产品经理，需要结构化工具来管理需求、分析和策略。
copy.tagline_en: Systematize product management with frameworks and templates
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a product manager needing structured tools for requirements, analysis, and strategy.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可调用脚本计算 RICE 优先级、分析访谈记录提取洞察，并按模板生成 PRD，还能使用发现与指标框架辅助产品规划。
howto.when: 当用户要求做功能优先级排序、客户访谈分析、需求文档编写等产品管理任务时触发。

say.text: 请用 RICE 方法给以下功能排序：搜索优化、一键分享。
分析这段客户访谈记录，提炼痛点与需求。
say.note: Claude 将运行访谈分析脚本，输出要点和严重程度。

say.text: 按标准 PRD 模板，为这个新功能写一份需求文档。
say.note: Claude 会参照模板生成带验收标准的文档。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can score features with RICE, analyze customer interviews, generate PRDs from templates, and include discovery and metric frameworks for product planning.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for feature prioritization, customer interview analysis, requirement documentation, or product strategy tasks.

say_en.text: Use RICE to prioritize these features: search optimization, one-click share.
say_en.note: Claude generates CSV, runs script, and returns ranking.

say_en.text: Analyze this customer interview transcript and list pain points and needs.
say_en.note: Claude runs the script and outputs pain points with severity.

say_en.text: Write a standard PRD for this new feature.
say_en.note: Claude uses the PRD template and adds acceptance criteria.
